summary: Wrote src/main.ts. It draws a ground plane and 10,000 instanced objects: 8,000 trees (an instanced trunk mesh and an instanced canopy mesh) and 2,000 instanced rocks. Placement comes from a seeded mulberry32 generator, so the forest is the same on every load. Canopies, trunks and rocks get per-instance colours through setColorAt. One shadow-casting directional light and FogExp2 are set up. The camera orbits slowly at radius 125 and height 70, looking at the origin, so the whole 120x120 forest stays in view. The loop runs on requestAnimationFrame and sets window.__EVAL_READY__ after the first frame. Typecheck passed. I did not run `vite build` or view the render in a browser. I lowered the fog density from 0.006 to 0.004 after the typecheck and did not re-run it.
